scope: Actual observed restoration comparator and bounded intended-depth source intake; no new synthetic data

data_source.registry: 48 source fracture-table teeth; G1-G4, T1-T12 each
data_source.source_ids: Original source row codes plus separately retained group/specimen-number columns; neither overwritten

group_mapping.G3: PICN inlay, composite not previously aged
group_mapping.G4: LDS inlay, composite not previously aged

states.baseline_Filling: Original composite restoration before inlay preparation; not a comparable baseline for inlay-tooth interface
states.R1: Prior composite loading only G1/G2; 240000 mechanical cycles
states.baseline_Inlay: After inlay placement before final loading block
states.R2: After common 1200000-cycle final mechanical loading block
states.terminal_fracture: Later destructive overload; face-category crack outcome and peak load, no fatigue event time

paired_primary.unit: one tooth per interface per state; no pooled face replicates
paired_primary.identity_policy: If source code and declared identity conflict, mark both source-code and destination teeth unresolved; strict subset omits the entire affected keys from linked means but preserves all 48 in registry. Conditional sensitivity trusts all row codes. Internally consistent does not mean externally verified.
paired_primary.estimand: Mean within-tooth postload minus baseline noncontinuous proportion among assessable margin, in percentage points, strict observed subset; no CI, test or causal contrast
paired_primary.full_scanned_uncertainty: For each record, gap/full to (gap+not_assessable)/full; a blank not_assessable field gives upper100%. Paired difference bounds [post_low-pre_high,post_high-pre_low], then equal-tooth means. Printed values only, no measurement-error model. Conservative not necessarily sharp; not-assessable portions may all be gaps or none.
paired_primary.geometry_limit: Nominal interface region, no registered pixels or local crack-growth trajectory

fracture.peak_load: Retain all literal numerical loads including 6.76N G1/T11
fracture.G1_diagnostic: Show omission of G1/T11 separately, neither a corrected datum nor a justified exclusion
fracture.face_hierarchy: Binary category indicators across four faces; any category at tooth level; modes not mutually exclusive
fracture.joint_question: Recorded positive noncontinuous length at either final inlay interface AND subsequent below-simulated-bone fracture
fracture.joint_bounds: All 48 registry denominator. Internally consistent linked positive known. Ambiguous margin identity and observed below-bone fracture unknown. Below-bone negative makes joint negative irrespective of margin identity. Bounds known/48 to (known+unknown)/48; no assertion of sharpness or same-time/causal association.

missingness.unknown_donor_ids: No donor-balanced mean or independent donor inference
missingness.repair_depth: Missing for all 48. Nominal cavity depths and CEJ-relative locations never substituted.
missingness.substrate: Optical tooth substance label, no record-specific enamel/dentin segmentation
missingness.fatigue_failure_time: Missing; peak force and experiment-wide no-debonding statement not substituted
missingness.source_blank_unassessable_fields: Retained unknown; no silent zero or LOD imputation
missingness.rounding_tolerance_meaning: Printed full-minus-nonassessable-minus-assessable length consistency only; no mechanical acceptance threshold

prior_bridge: Reuse missing depth/leakage/fatigue handlers from studies/checklist-mechanisms-2026-10-19/dental/analyze_linked_material_outcomes.py; retain assay-specific unavailable states
full_restoration_contract: Original natural enamel volume/thickness and architecture
Original pose and load stability after finite support withdrawal
stopping_rule: Four primary candidates screened; eight retained files. Stop after a usable partial observed comparator and do not pursue opaque large workbook or contact authors.
